headline: Your Threads. In your chat.
intro: Create a Meta app, get a token, and connect your account. Already have a token? Paste it into the form.
create_app_help: Open the developer dashboard and select Access the Threads API when creating your app.
add_account_help: Under App roles → Roles, add yourself as a Threads Tester. Accept the invitation under website permissions in your Threads settings.
generate_token_help: Return to the Threads API settings in Meta and find the user token generator. Reading your profile requires threads_basic.
verify_help: We will verify the account it belongs to and save the connection.
token_hint: Paste the full token. App ID and App Secret are not needed here.
privacy: The token stays on this computer. The model only receives the connection result and profile data.
footer: Social MCP · Your accounts, under your control.
return_to_chat: You can close this page and return to the chat.
invalid_query: URL query parameters are not supported.
invalid_origin: Submit the form from the connection page.
invalid_token: Check the form: provide exactly one non-empty Threads token.
expired: This connection link is no longer valid.
invalid_connection: Could not connect the account. Check the token and try again.
